race.comment: KEVIN (5) has been getting closer with every start of late and finally got another win on the board. He did step back to the shortest of courses at Narromine so this is not easy but is aided by the inside draw which for a speed horse is priceless. SUPREME STYLE (11) didn't really get into her race when resuming. Her best effort of late came when leading so maybe they try that tactic again. I AM WILD (8) gets a tongue-tie on now. Likely needs more ground but can run on. LINE OF LAW (6) was good two back. Got too far back two weeks ago. Can run a race in this company.
